svg.title: Multi-agent AI orchestration

g.text: Complex multi-step problem requiring specialized expertise
Analyzes task → selects appropriate agent(s) → manages state
Thought chain • Tool results • Intermediate conclusions • Confidence scores
Approve / reject / iterate with agents before final response
